metadata:
  udi: prismata.tooling.schema.config-merge
  name: ConfigMergeSettings
  version: 1.0.0
  kind: schema-definition
  description: Mergeable configuration schema for ConfigMerge primitive.

fields:
  conflictMode:
    type: string
    enum:
      - removeWins
      - includeWins
      - unionWins
      - cliWins
    default: unionWins
    description: >
      Controls how include*/exclude* conflicts are resolved after all layers are merged.

  includeTypes:
    type: array
    items: { type: string }

  excludeTypes:
    type: array
    items: { type: string }

  includeFolders:
    type: array
    items: { type: string }

  excludeFolders:
    type: array
    items: { type: string }

  includePatterns:
    type: array
    items: { type: string }

  excludePatterns:
    type: array
    items: { type: string }

  includeAttributes:
    type: array
    items: { type: string }

  excludeAttributes:
    type: array
    items: { type: string }

  mode:
    type: string

  outputFormat:
    type: string

  colourKeyPath:
    type: string
    default: null
    description: >
      Optional path to an alternate COLOURS/COLOUR_KEY JSON file. This path
      is treated as an optional override and is passed through the merge
      precedence chain without altering existing precedence semantics.
